answer: Randomly audited work bonds require collateral for every concurrent job. An orchard survey reporting violet counts must survive a hidden reference check; an echo from another account is not evidence. Failed checks burn the job's bond, so N simultaneous claims lock N bonds even under one owner. Set the audit probability times the slash above the maximum fraud payoff. This assumes trustworthy, unpredictable reference checks; colluding auditors or cheap loans can weaken the deterrent.
